problem_type: A shared diagnostic catch overwrites upstream assertion and cancellation errors
symptom: App74 reports geometry not settled after 647ms even though its configured wait is 5000ms; the actual failure is FEEL font-size drift 4>0 after waitForFunction succeeds.
direct_cause: waitForVisualQuiescence catches every waitForFunction rejection, including the FEEL checkpoint wrapper's ordinary Error, and replaces it with a geometry/animation timeout without cause.
class_root: Diagnostic enrichment must require the canonical typed wait timeout; an unrelated rejection must retain its original identity, message, cause and failure state.
affected_population: FEEL checkpoints, AbortError and other wait wrapper failures
internal_only_reason: The failure is internal catch ownership. Installed @playwright/test and playwright TimeoutError exports were checked to be the identical constructor; real FEEL observer code supplies the drift failure in the targeted unit without launching a browser.
invariants: Only an instanceof canonical Playwright TimeoutError rejection receives visual-quiescence diagnostics
All other rejected values are rethrown unchanged, without diagnostic evaluation or continued settled screenshot
Typed timeout keeps the existing geometry/animation message and original error as cause
Success still clears fingerprint before screenshot; 3 stable frames, 5000ms default, polling and screenshot arguments remain unchanged
Do not change FEEL rules/baselines, visual standards, production code, coordinator tree, PNGs or App behavior

door_reduction.why_not: Generated by mapDoors/doorsForTargets for waitForVisualQuiescence over tests/ux and scripts including tests; HEAD test source is the before input. Existing 20 direct consumer-file doors remain legitimate shared-helper consumers; one additional door exercises the same helper in its existing test. The screenshot/theme wrappers are followed one hop in _assert; no per-consumer patch or alternate diagnostic path is introduced.

generality_proof: The earliest shared catch checks the actual Playwright error type, not text/name or caller. The actual installFeelObserver wrapper succeeds its original wait then throws a real font-size drift; screenshotSettled must preserve that exact error and skip quiescence diagnostics. AbortError, ordinary Error with timeout wording, spoofed TimeoutError name, TypeError and non-Error rejection controls prove the class boundary. Real TimeoutError instances retain existing animation/geometry diagnostics and cause, even when diagnostic evaluation fails. The actual cleanup callback executes in a Node VM and deletes fingerprint before success screenshot.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Classify the original rejection before optional timeout enrichment and retain causal identity

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Awaits the shared helper before screenshot, including the real FEEL-wrapped wait regression
Calls the same shared helper after applying existing theme attributes; no wrapper change is needed
The existing checkpoint and strict 4>0 drift remain untouched; the helper no longer mislabels their thrown Error

recurrence.reason: Any non-timeout failure from a public wait wrapper can be rewritten by the same catch on any page or platform.
same_class_scan: Read complete quiescence catch, success cleanup, screenshot and theme wrappers
Read FEEL checkpoint drift throw and public wait wrappers
Read existing _assert and feel-policy tests and Vitest include configuration
Generated exact direct-call census and followed screenshot/theme wrappers one hop
Verified canonical Playwright TimeoutError constructor equality with the runtime export

prevention.invariant: Only a genuine typed Playwright timeout can be relabeled as visual-quiescence timeout
prevention.failure_mode: Non-timeout rejection is thrown unchanged; typed timeout remains a rejection with existing diagnostics and original cause
prevention.strategy: Guard the earliest shared catch with instanceof canonical errors.TimeoutError and attach the original error using Error cause

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove catch-all rejection-to-quiescence-timeout rewriting; do not remove waits, diagnostics, screenshots or FEEL enforcement.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency or API replacement; reuse the installed Playwright public errors.TimeoutError export, whose runtime identity is explicitly verified.

migration: No project data or caller migration. Existing helper signatures, default timing, polling and success cleanup remain unchanged.
residual_risks: No App/browser/PNG/Provider or heavy gate run; actual App74 rerun and independent D review remain coordination acceptance
Node protocol fixtures exercise real shared catch and FEEL policy/wrapper but do not claim real DOM settling or actual screenshot pixels
The root-cause checker's test-path heuristic may classify this executable shared harness as test-only; its real runtime catch is the changed structural prevention, not an exemption or baseline change
